messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need a temporary burst hold + warm pool in asia-southeast-3 for the new cluster bring-up tomorrow morning. This is to avoid cold-starts during validation runs. Need quota request + network preflight. ticket: https://rwd.company/t/INC-3247

aj: Numbers? GPUs, duration, and whether this is reserved or burst?

maria: Rough ask: 40 x A100-80GB for 48h (warm/validation), 10 x T4 for staging and canaries for 72h. Fallback plan: drop to 20 A100 if procurement pushes back. Estimated token-hours: ~3.6M.

cheng: For GCP we should request both quota + region-specific reservation. Use qreq CLI with --burst-mode to get temporary backend reservation. Also need cloud router + peering reviewed (MTU + custom routes).

maria: Adding the qreq snippet here, copy/paste and adjust the spreadsheet link:

```bash
qreq create --project=redwood-prod --region=asia-southeast-3 \
  --gpus=\"A100:40,T4:10\" --duration=72h --purpose=\"cluster-bringup:validation+canary\" \
  --billing_code=DEV-OPS-2026-09 --fastpath
```

maria: Spreadsheet: https://docs.rwd.company/spreadsheets/cluster-warmup-apse3 (numbers + cost calc)

devops-bot: qreq submitted by aj — ticket #QREQ-11234 created. ETA for quota reply: 24-48h. See: https://rwd.company/qreq/QREQ-11234 :white_check_mark:

procurement: FYI @maria @aj — budget ok for temporary burst, but we need PO code and predicted spend cap. Reserved monthly commit would save ~27% vs burst. If you expect >7 days, we should convert to reserved immediately.

aj: I'll attach PO=PO-778 and set spend cap to $42k for the 3-day window. Filing the qreq now and pinging infra-ops to validate peering.

cheng: Also add the canary roll plan — route 10% traffic to warm pool, fallback to hosted models if latency >200ms for 3 consecutive mins. Documented in runbook: https://rwd.company/runbooks/cluster-bringup-checklist

sre-oncall: Quick note: last time we saw packet drops during warmup because MTU on the peered router defaulted to 1400; validation scripts should include an iperf + MTU check. Add this to the preflight checklist.

maria: Good catch. I'll add iperf/mtu to the preflight steps and include runbook entries. Will hand off to oncall at 0500 UTC tomorrow for the final go/no-go.

aj: On it. I'll post progress updates in this thread and ping @sre-oncall before we flip traffic.

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: qreq followup in 18h (automated).

maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for the handoff. If procurement/ops approve earlier we can start warm pool preflight tonight. :thumbsup:
